## Guest Lecture on Stress Management by Dr. P.C.B. Gupta at MGIT

News Date : 08 Jun 2024News ReportThe Career Development Cell (CDC) of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology(MGIT) organised a Guest lecture on “Stress Management” on 8th June 2024 (Saturday) from 10.00 AM to 11.00 AM in A-Block Auditorium. The speaker is Dr. P.C.B. Gupta, Professor, Department of Psychiatry, Institute of Mental Health, Erragadda, Hyderabad.
